newsitem.title: USA: BU's KeySpan seeking engineering firm.
newsitem.headline: BU's KeySpan seeking engineering firm.

text.p: Brooklyn Union Gas Co said Thursday its KeySpan subsidiaries plan to acquire an engineering firm as part of their continued expansion in the competitive energy market of the Northeast.

The utility said KeySpan recently acquired a major heating, ventilation and air conditioning contracting firm, and explained acquisitions such as these enhance its ability to provide one-stop energy services.
It said the KeySpan units had third quarter, ended June 30, losses of $1.1 million, or $0.02 per Brooklyn Union share, and nine month losses of $3.4 million, or $0.07 per share.
The subsidiaries started operations within the last year.

KeySpan Energy Services Inc, based in Stamford, Conn., is now the largest retailer of natural gas in New York, supplying over 6 billion cubic feet of gas per year to more than 13,000 customers in New York, New Jersey and Ohio, the utility said.

Headquartered in Jericho, N.Y., KeySpan Energy Management Inc provides a range of energy service options to commercial and industrial facilities in the New York metropolitan area, including project financing, operations and maintenance services, installation of turnkey energy systems and fuel-management services. ((-- New York Newsdesk 212 859-1610))
